subtitle: Career Design for Electrical and Electronic Engineers
teachers:
FUKAMI Tadashi
授業科目の学習・教育目標
keywords: Recommended Subjects in the Specialized Field
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) understand "Academic Field" of the two courses in the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering.
(2) understand the specialized subject groups in each field, which start from 3rd term.
(3) understand outlines of the subject group to determine the specialized field.
(4) summarize study and registration plans using logical sentences.
advice:
This is a career design course to clarify future field of student and the image of electrical / electronic engineers and researchers. Students will understand what to learn from now on, and make study and registration plans using logical sentences.
1. Self-analysis and career design
Students will investigate technical trends and industry/corporate with relation to electric and electronic engineering, and set goals for higher education/employment.
2. Understanding specialized fields and required subjects in the course (compulsory subject)
Through classes and surveys, students will understand outlines of specialized fields and required subjects (compulsory subjects) for electrical engineering course and electronic engineering course. In addition, students will understand the relationship between laboratories in Design project III and the required subjects of each course.
3. Determination of course and making study/registration plans
Students will determine their course and clarify their learning objectives. After that, students will summarize their study/registration plans from 4th term.
requiredKnowledge:
(1) Students should actively ask questions and deepen their understanding.
(2) Students are encouraged to take specialized subjects so as to take into account their future design.
(3) It is important to read the textbooks used for each subject on a daily basis and to try to understand the context by remembering the meaning of the technical terms in the subject.

activityGoals.body: Be able to investigate trends in technology related to electrical and electronic engineering.

Be able to clearly explain your learning goals after 4th term.

Be able to express yourself thoughts as a logical and clear statement.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Explain the overall situation in each of the broad fields of electrical and electronic engineering.
(2) Assuming that you have worked or become an expert in that field in the future, think about what you can do with your aptitude and draw objective visions in various technical fields.
(3) In order to become an active electrical and electronic engineer, fully understand what you need to learn at the university, make study and registration plans for acquisition, and express compelling, logical and clear sentences.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a career design course to clarify future field of student and the image of electrical / electronic engineers and researchers. Students will understand what to learn from now on, and make study and registration plans using logical sentences.
1. Self-analysis and career design
Students will investigate technical trends and industry/corporate with relation to electric and electronic engineering, and set goals for higher education/employment.
2. Understanding specialized fields and required subjects in the course (compulsory subject)
Through classes and surveys, students will understand outlines of specialized fields and required subjects (compulsory subjects) for electrical engineering course and electronic engineering course. In addition, students will understand the relationship between laboratories in Design project III and the required subjects of each course.
3. Determination of course and making study/registration plans
Students will determine their course and clarify their learning objectives. After that, students will summarize their study/registration plans from 4th term.

(3) It is important to read the textbooks used for each subject on a daily basis and to try to understand the context by remembering the meaning of the technical terms in the subject.
